# 4 Ezra Chapter 1 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** 5th Ezra (Christian addition)

---

**1:1** The word of the LORD came to Ezra son of Saraias, son of Azarias, son of Helkias, son of Salemas, son of Sadoc, son of Achitob,

**1:2** son of Achias, son of Phinees, son of Heli, son of Amarias, son of Aziei, son of Marimoth, son of Arna, son of Ozias, son of Borith, son of Abisei, son of Phinees, son of Eleazar,

**1:3** son of Aaron, of the tribe of Levi, who was a captive in the land of the Medes in the reign of Artaxerxes king of the Persians.

**1:4** And the word of the LORD came to me, saying:

**1:5** Go, declare to my people their evil deeds, and to their children the iniquities they have committed against me, that they may tell their children's children,

**1:6** because the sins of their fathers have multiplied in them, for they have forgotten me and sacrificed to foreign gods.

**1:7** Was it not I who brought them out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage? Yet they provoked me to anger and despised my counsel.

**1:8** Pull out the hairs of your head and cast all evils upon them, for they have not obeyed my law — they are a rebellious people.

**1:9** How long shall I endure them, upon whom I have bestowed such great benefits? For their sake I overthrew many kings; I struck down Pharaoh with his servants and all his host.

**1:10** All the nations I destroyed before them; in the east I scattered the peoples of Tyre and Sidon, and slew all their enemies.

**1:11** Speak to them therefore, saying: Thus says the LORD:

**1:12** I led you through the sea and made broad roads for you from the beginning; I gave you Moses as leader and Aaron as priest.

**1:13** I gave you light by a pillar of fire and performed great wonders among you. Yet you have forgotten me, says the LORD.

**1:14** Thus says the LORD Almighty: The quails were a sign for you; I gave you camps for your protection, yet you murmured there.

**1:15** You did not prevail in my name over your enemies; to this day you still murmur.

**1:16** Where are the mercies I showed you? When you were hungry and thirsty in the wilderness, did you not cry out to me,

**1:17** saying: Why have you led us into this wilderness to kill us? It would have been better to serve the Egyptians than to die in this desert.

**1:18** I was grieved by your groaning and gave you manna for food; you ate the bread of angels.

**1:19** When you were thirsty, did I not split the rock and water flowed abundantly? Because of the heat I covered you with leaves of the forest.

**1:20** I divided fertile lands for you; I drove out the Canaanites, the Perizzites, and the Philistines before you. What more could I have done for you? says the LORD.

**1:21** Thus says the LORD Almighty: When you were in the wilderness, at the bitter waters, thirsty and blaspheming my name,

**1:22** I did not send fire upon you for your blasphemies but cast a tree into the water and made the stream sweet.

**1:23** What shall I do with you, O Jacob? You, Judah, would not obey me. I will turn to other nations and give them my name, that they may keep my statutes.

**1:24** Because you have forsaken me, I also will forsake you; when you ask mercy of me, I will show no mercy.

**1:25** When you call upon me I will not hear you, for you have defiled your hands with blood and your feet are swift to commit murder.

**1:26** It is not I alone whom you have forsaken — you have forsaken your very selves, says the LORD.

**1:27** Thus says the LORD Almighty: Have I not entreated you as a father entreats his sons, as a mother her daughters, and a nurse her little children,

**1:28** that you should be my people and I should be your God, that you should be my sons and I should be your father?

**1:29** I gathered you as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings. But now what shall I do with you? I will cast you away from my presence.

**1:30** When you offer oblations to me I will turn my face from you, for I have rejected your feast days and new moons and your circumcisions of the flesh.

**1:31** I sent you my servants the prophets, but you took and killed them and tore their bodies in pieces; I will require their blood at your hands, says the LORD.

**1:32** Thus says the LORD Almighty: Your house is desolate; I will drive you out as the wind drives straw.

**1:33** Your children shall not be fruitful, for they have neglected my commandment and done what is evil before me.

**1:34** I will give your houses to a people yet to come, who without having heard me will believe; to those to whom I have shown no signs, they will do what I have commanded.

**1:35** They have not seen the prophets yet will remember their ancient heritage; I will give the testimony of the first people to these, and they shall be my people, and for their leaders an everlasting covenant.

**1:36** Their children delight in me and I will show them salvation, for they have received the Holy Spirit from me, and I will declare to them everlasting things.

**1:37** Do not regard, therefore, the fall of those rejected nations; for since they would not obey my commandments, they shall not be written in the book of life.
